title: terraform: unify private state layout + add gpu node pools, iam and networking modules
author: Evan Marshall
description: Combine multiple private-deployment Terraform state layouts into a single canonical layout and introduce modular GPU node pools, IAM roles, and networking building blocks for Private deployments. This change unifies state file layout to make cross-account imports, upgrades, and drift detection predictable; extracts GPU node pool configuration into a reusable module with clear inputs for instance types, accelerator profiles, and autoscaling policies; provides dedicated IAM modules for node and service roles with least-privilege defaults; and consolidates VPC/subnet/route table networking into a composable networking module. Includes migration helpers and a documented upgrade path that performs a state move + targeted apply to avoid resource replacement. Key goals: 1) enable consistent upgrades across on-prem and cloud-based Private installers, 2) reduce duplicated Terraform code across customer overlays, 3) make rollback and state migration explicit and auditable. Changes are backwards-compatible for existing customers following the migration instructions; no automatic state rewrite is performed.
